snippet.title: Drawing my friends in Portrait Mode at PartyMashup.com
snippet.description:
We played Portrait Mode, our free browser-based party game where you and your friends take selfies and draw each other!

Portrait Mode is free to play at PartyMashup.com. All you need is a browser and at least one other person to play with, whether you're in the same room or on a call together.

Party Mashup Games is an indie studio run by siblings David and Katherine. We design and build all of our games ourselves, down to the music and art. Portrait Mode is our third game and we have more on the way.
Try it yourself at PartyMashup.com and let us know what you think in the comments!
